rationale:
This is an unranked roster of 15 distinct advisors, not an experiment selection. Retain strassen_one_level to review distinct legal schedules and FP32 rounding risks. The measured three-buffer wrapper passed correctness but lost all ten pairs; its rejection does not establish which component caused the regression or reject the entire algorithm family. Packing, scratch, vector-access, cache and loop advisors cover dense256 conversion, workspace, recombination and classical alternatives. Compiler, assembly and streaming advisors cover code generation and valid SME boundaries without claiming component speedups. Tile, register-reuse and transpose-fusion advisors cover the four available ZA.S tiles. Fast-path and tail advisors cover dispatch, allocation failure, general shapes and bounds.

Replace sme_fp32_schedule and general_c_fallback with register_reuse and b_panel_layout to broaden n512 proposals while retaining fallback review. Require distinct source changes: no repeats of the rejected three-buffer schedule, panel32 wrappers, full-B packing, or unchanged unrolls. A 32-row panel across K512 requires 64 KiB, not 32 KiB.

Fresh battery baseline peak: 1102.214208818538 GFLOP/s; paired-control peak for the rejected Strassen wrapper: 1091.5737628886607. Historical peaks remain separate: Battery Automatic 1668.5964359101147; AC initial baseline 1685.6230608449698; later AC unchanged control 1687.3925479742732. No goal completion is established. Advice remains unverified. The board jointly ranks proposals; all fixed correctness, timing, power, budget, ten-pair promotion and held-out gates remain unchanged.
